posts.content_md:
Andres had his table set up for copying and rather than tear it down and set up for mastering came by on Sunday and we spent the afternoon tinkering with a clock.

[](http://www.dragonseye.com/gallery/v/family/MichaelH/holography/ClockSetup.jpg.html)

It's a small clock with a lens over the front and originally he'd wanted to do a two-channel of the front and back but settled on a single channel showing off the front with a bit of the back reflected in a mirror.

Please don't look too closely at the mirror. I didn't realize how filthy it was until we took the pictures.

Here's the transmission master.

[](http://www.dragonseye.com/gallery/v/family/MichaelH/holography/ClockTransmission.jpg.html)

He left for the day planning on making some copies so hopefully he'll post some pictures on his site. *nudge*
